items.quote: They stopped throwing strikes when the drums started.
Wind shifted in the 8th. Changed everything.
You could hear the ball hit the glove.
No one moved until the bat cracked. Then the whole section stood up.
The stadium lights made the infield look like a sheet of paper.
The chant started as a joke. By the 6th, it was law.
You don’t notice the sea until the flags stop moving.
The scoreboard said nothing. The crowd knew anyway.
Two pitches in, you could tell the catcher didn’t trust the fastball.
